claims.statement: Polish law places photovoltaic panels in WEEE group 4 and lets a producer perform covered duties itself or through a statutory electrical-equipment recovery organization under a written contract, without eliminating producer responsibility.

A Polish statutory WEEE recovery organization must be a joint-stock company formed and owned only by producers, introducers, their employer associations, or chambers, with at least 5 million PLN paid fully in cash before registration and not financed by debt.
The same entity must maintain environmental management, fund public education, and undergo annual external audit, adding fixed compliance burden beyond recycler contracts and BDO software.
Incumbents already bundle producer-duty assumption, BDO reporting, collection networks, processing, recovery, and recycling for importers.
Poland's more than 1.6 million renewable microinstallations, 99.9% photovoltaic, create a large eventual waste base, but most recent installations will not return for many years.

contrary_evidence: The statutory 5 million PLN cash capital floor is over 75 times the discovery-stage 65000 PLN budget and cannot be funded by a loan or credit.
Only specified producer-side entities may own shares in the recovery organization, constraining the founder's equity path.
ElektroEko, ELECTRO-SYSTEM, and TOM already provide the compliance, reporting, network, and treatment bundle.
A software or referral layer using an incumbent's authorization would not control the producer-duty relationship described by the frozen candidate.

economics.acquisition_route: The frozen statutory collective would have to recruit eligible producer-shareholders before launch and compete directly for importer duty-transfer contracts against established national organizations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Not conservatively credible in the frozen form: the minimum statutory capital alone is 5 million PLN, debt cannot fund it, eligible shareholder classes are restricted, and the founder has only 100000-200000 PLN available.
economics.founder_time: Management could be delegated operationally, but shareholder recruitment, compliance oversight, recycler contracting, audits, and importer sales cannot be reduced to a part-time software operation at inception.
economics.gross_margin_basis: No reliable margin can be modeled before collection liabilities, guarantees, treatment prices, 5% education spending, audit, and incumbent contract pricing are known.
economics.payback: At 3000 PLN annual membership, 1667 member-years equal the 5 million PLN statutory capital before any collection, treatment, staff, audit, or acquisition cost; this is not a payback case.
economics.pricing: The proposed 3000 PLN annual fee plus 0.12 PLN per kilogram remains unvalidated and cannot overcome the pre-registration capital requirement.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Producer reporting and financing duties recur, but incumbent recovery organizations already hold the recurring contracts and producer responsibility remains legally sensitive.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A serial-to-material-flow ledger tied to statutory producer contracts and funded take-back execution
fingerprint.customer: Small photovoltaic-panel and inverter producers or importers placing equipment on the Polish market
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct importer enrollment plus customs, accounting, and wholesale referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Statutory WEEE recovery organization pooling reporting, collection, treatment, and financial obligations
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The producer pays under a written annual duty-transfer contract and by equipment mass placed on market
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A producer or importer must register, report, finance, collect, and evidence compliant end-of-life treatment

founder_fit: Renewable-sector family access and data automation fit the subject matter.
The 5 million PLN non-debt capital floor is incompatible with the founder's available 100000-200000 PLN.
Restricted statutory ownership and high-touch producer recruitment weaken the founder-equity and part-time fit.
risks: Operating as the described collective without satisfying statutory form, ownership, capital, environmental-management, and audit requirements is unlawful.
Collection and product-fee liabilities can exceed per-kilogram revenue when returns or commodity values move adversely.
Incumbents can bundle reporting and national treatment networks at scale.
PV return timing may lag current placed-on-market growth for decades.

structure.control_point: Statutory producer contract, placed-on-market reporting, and financed collection and treatment
structure.critical_dependency: Eligibility, 5 million PLN non-debt paid-in capital, environmental-management certification, audit, and compliant treatment network

thesis: Aggregate small photovoltaic importers through a Polish statutory WEEE recovery organization that assumes contracted reporting, collection, and treatment duties and maintains serial-level material-flow records.
title: PV Producer-Responsibility Clearinghouse
uncertainties: No evidence establishes that eligible producer-shareholders would contribute the required 5 million PLN.
Incumbent per-kilogram contract pricing, switching behavior, and customer-acquisition cost are unknown.
The mass and timing of Polish PV-panel returns by installation cohort are not established.
Treatment, guarantee, audit, insurance, and product-fee exposure have not been quoted.
